values.note: Book online, by phone or in person; payment in full when booking. Renter must be 21. From 2027 any cancellation forfeits one night plus $10, and two nights within 3 days of arrival.

booking.source: Park page ('Now accepting reservations 12 months in advance'; Cancellation Policy Effective January 1, 2027); 2027 brochure ('3-night minimum on holidays and 2-night minimum for all other reservations'; 'Campers may not stay in the same site for more than 14 consecutive days'; 'You must be 21 years of age to rent a site')

note: Shawano County's campground on Shawano Lake, with a large sandy beach, a dog beach, a boat launch and short-term docks across the day-use area. Pontoon, personal watercraft, canoe, kayak and paddleboard rentals; snack shop. ATVs/UTVs are not allowed in the park April through October. --Claude
summary: County reservation site, 2027 brochure, map, rules and booking calendar read. 102 sites (93 W/E 50-amp on blacktop pads, 8 electric tent sites, 1 ADA). 2027: $40 W/E, $45 holidays; 2-night minimum (3 on holidays), 14-day limit; 2027 booking calendar runs Apr 26 - Oct 31. Lakeview NOT supported: the loops sit 120-300 m from the lake under tree canopy behind the day-use area, N Shore Dr and a residential strip: downgrade to not waterfront. Google 4.6 (962).
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakeview -> not waterfront (no --AWH value): on the county map every campsite (1-90, tent 91-98) lies north of the day-use field, beach and N Shore Dr; Esri imagery shows the loops under continuous tree canopy 120-300 m from the shore, with the lakeside residential strip and its docks between the eastern loops and the water. The nearest RV sites (about 10-12 and 21-23, near 44.8262,-88.5300) are ~110 m+ from the water through trees and houses. Tent sites 97-98 by the volleyball court are ~55 m from the beach over day-use ground but are tent-only. The beach is a short walk across the day-use area.
